interventions.detail: Linux needs the [cpu] extra (mlx is a Darwin-only dependency); installed -e mlx-lm[cpu] into a uv Python 3.12 venv
mlx_lm/utils.py load(): cast the model to float32 on the CPU device because bf16/fp16 quantized matmul on CPU is 10-50x slower (a forward pass took ~8 min)
Predownloaded mlx-community/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct-4bit into HF_HOME=/work/hf_cache, set in env.sh
